idea: RutaLeche Peru is an offline-first mobile app that uses machine learning to optimize milk collection routes for Peruvian dairy cooperatives and processing plants.

selected_gap.title: Offline-First Mobile App for Remote Milk Collection
selected_gap.pain: Rural areas lack reliable internet, making real-time optimization useless and forcing drivers to rely on paper and memory, leading to delays and errors.
selected_gap.why_now: Smartphone penetration is high in rural Peru; offline sync technology is mature and can bridge the connectivity gap.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Test offline-capable MVP with drivers in remote regions and compare on-time collection and data accuracy against manual methods.
selected_gap.risk: Infrastructure may improve faster than expected; offline sync adds development complexity and maintenance overhead.

idea: A lightweight, offline-first mobile application that uses on-device machine learning to generate optimal milk collection routes for small dairy cooperatives in the Peruvian highlands, where cellular connectivity is unreliable. The app works without internet during route planning and execution, syncing data later when connectivity is restored, directly targeting cooperatives losing 20-30% of milk due to spoilage from inefficient routing and lack of real-time data.
